messages:
Sam Chen: Dropped v3 of the launch blog in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example. Need legal + product + eng eyes. Target publish Wed 09:00 PT. Quick asks: confirm hero claim (latency/cost numbers), CTO quote, and webinar CTA mapping.
Lia Torres: reading now. suggest moving the benchmark section up — readers want numbers earlier.
Oliver Park: numbers look reasonable but need an explicit baseline. '60% cost reduction' vs what? can we say 'vs unoptimized 7B endpoint'?
Sam Chen: good call. Raj — can you confirm the benchmarking baseline + one-liner for hero stats?
Raj Patel: confirmed. p50 ~85ms for 8k context on Dedicated (batch=8). token cost ~0.7¢/k using our Optimize profile + prefix caching. margin ~±10%. Suggest hero: "~85ms p50 latency, ~0.7¢/k token cost" — short and verifiable.
Nina Gomez: perfect. For webinar CTA: primary = Register for live, secondary = Download benchmarks PDF. HubSpot tags: launch-live, bench-pdf. Also want a Sales 2-sentence blurb to use in outreach.
Sam Chen: adding proposed HubSpot routing snippet for ops check: ```{"route":"/thanks","tags":["launch-live","bench-pdf"],"notify":"webinar@redwood.com"}``` someone sanity-checks?
Lia Torres: looks fine. Ops/marketing should confirm webhook email. Also small copy request: change header from 'Massive cost savings' to 'Significant cost savings' per legal preference.
legal-bot: Automated check: any explicit 'cost' or 'latency' claims require an attached measurement source and a measurement summary. See policy: /policies/marketing-claims. Please attach raw eval logs or spreadsheet.
Raj Patel: uploaded raw evals and config: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/benchmark-uploads. Note: runs used model-x-8q, batch=8, quant=4-bit. I'll pin the exact command and seed in the sheet.
Oliver Park: we should get a CTO quote. Sam, can you ask Aisha or Marcus for a short line on reliability and performance? If not by EOD, remove placeholder.
Sam Chen: pinged @Aisha and @Marcus for quotes. also flagged product for a 1-sentence acceptance note.
Nina Gomez: for webinar flow — landing page copy I can draft today. Also recommend we gate the PDF behind email capture and tag for 'bench-pdf' so Sales gets leads.
Lia Torres: approvals timeline: legal quick-pass by tomorrow noon, product sign-off by EOD tomorrow. if both green -> ops will schedule publish + webinar invite.
legal-bot: Suggestion: replace 'massive' with 'significant' accepted. Flagged for human review.
Raj Patel: one more ops note — screenshots need PII/customer obfuscation. I'll scrub v1 and upload sanitized versions to /assets/screens.
Sam Chen: thanks. final asks: Lia to craft Sales blurb (2 sentences); Nina to finalize webinar registration copy; Raj to attach measurement summary to the doc; legal to confirm final wording. can someone book a 30m sync 11:30 PT?
Lia Torres: booked 11:30-12:00 PT — invite sent.
Nina Gomez: :thumbsup: I'll wire the registration page and pass to growth-ops.
Sam Chen: great — moving this to 'final review' in the doc. will update thread when legal approves.
